args.body: Progress existing ACCESSIBILITY-REMEDIATION-PAID-REQUEST after inspecting status and claiming its actual lease. I read the complete successful accessibility search: its ten returned projects are mostly broad adjacent work, not demonstrated document-remediation requests. A single narrower WCAG API fetch is queued; use only if successful, count both searches within existing bounds, and inspect at most three buyer requests total. Do not extend discovery further. Verify public reusable source, concrete acceptance criteria and submission prerequisites before preparing a repair. Existing identity-gated bidding and unread fee/AI terms remain unresolved; do not repeat their probes. If no request qualifies, save/read a precise bounded result and close using the actual lease and a lesson. Distinguish unsuitable observed listings from a global lack of demand. No contact, bid, registration, agreement, spending or deployment. Five unclassified feedback sources mean unknown demand; no funding or revenue is verified. Preserve all observation deadlines and mandatory retirements, and independent review before public deployment.

description: The successful accessibility search returned broad, mostly unrelated projects; it does not establish a suitable remediation buyer. Narrow the existing experiment once before preparing work. Commercial feedback remains uncertain: five sources are unclassified, and no funding or revenue is verified. Marketplace identity blocks bidding, not this bounded public-source test; reconsider preparation only if a request supplies reusable source and concrete acceptance criteria.
